## Observed Facts

- **Data Scope:** OpenStack dataset, all time, filtered to messages containing instance ID 544fd51c-4edc-4780-baae-ba1d80a0acfc.
- The instance has **28 Log Entries** [E1], all at level INFO. **0 are ERROR** [E4].
- All 28 fall on a single day, 2017-05-14 [E3]. They come from 5 Components: nova.compute.manager (12), nova.compute.claims (8), nova.virt.libvirt.driver (5), nova.osapi_compute.wsgi.server (2), and nova.api.openstack.compute.server_external_events (1) [E2].
- The timeline in E5 shows a complete lifecycle: resource claim (21:07:37), spawn, VM started, instance spawned successfully (21:08:19), then DELETE API call, termination, and VM stopped (21:08:42). All within about 65 seconds [E5].
- Spawn took **41.81 seconds** on the hypervisor and the full build took **42.81 seconds** [E5, lines 201366 and 201369].
- The entries come from a file named `openstack_abnormal.log` [E5]. Nothing in the entries themselves is an error.

## Hypotheses

- The instance itself looks healthy. It was created, started, and then deleted on request, with no failure recorded.
- The ~42-second build time is the one measurable point that is slow. If build times are a concern for your team, this is worth a look, but a single instance cannot show whether it is a trend.
- The file name `openstack_abnormal.log` suggests this sequence was tagged as abnormal in the source dataset. The entries show no error, so the tag most likely reflects something outside these log lines.

## Unknowns

- Why the file is named "abnormal" and whether the 42-second spawn is the reason. The logs do not say.
- Whether the deletion was intended. The DELETE request came from the API, but the logs do not show who sent it or why.
- Whether this instance had any user or business impact. The logs cannot establish that.
- Whether the 42-second spawn is typical for this host. That needs comparison against other instances, which I have not run.

## Next Step

No need to escalate this instance on the evidence here. If you want to act on the slow spawn, I can check how many other instances on the same Component show spawn times above 40 seconds. That would tell you whether this is a one-off or a pattern.
